attributes.action: Conduct a review into Immigration Policy announced by the Home Secretary.
attributes.additional_details: We have taken people in because we believe in fairness, protecting others who have fallen victim to harm & threat. We have been extremely tolerant even though some of us have been harmed! The UK is not a Life-Boat to the World, we are sovereign countries within, we are generally peaceful, easy going, polite, reserved, respectful so when are our wishes going to actually receive the respect we ask for? Thousands of Asylum Seekers may enter Britain under a new community scheme! Debate is required.
attributes.background:
We call on the government to conduct a review concerning the Home Secretary`s recently unveiled plan for Asylum Seekers, how our society will be impacted particularly where they are relocated.
We believe Immigration should be carefully considered as to how existing society will be affected.

rejection.details:
We understand that you're concerned about Government policy relating to asylum seekers but we're not exactly sure what changes you'd like to see. 

You could start a new petition explaining clearly what you would like the Government or Parliament to do. For example, you could start a new petition calling for the planned new community sponsorship scheme for asylum seekers to be scrapped, if that's something that you'd like to happen. 

You can find out more about current legal humanitarian routes to the UK including the Governments planned new community sponsorship-based schemes in this House of Commons Library note: https://commonslibrary.parliament.uk/research-briefings/cbp-9630/
